descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S03 Existing specs: the Pending Tasks prompt and completion — Keep keeps the task, Cancel leaves the button, Delete removes only the pending tasks, 0 open tasks skips the prompt, completion waits for the derived data

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 With pending tasks, 'Mark Encounter Complete' opens the Pending Tasks prompt with three choices, and each works: Delete & complete deletes the pending tasks and completes; … (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 8; TFA-92595 How it works 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T5 The Pending Tasks prompt appears exactly when tasks remain: never with 0 open tasks, always with ≥1, listing the open tasks; never before the encounter's derived tasks are in. (TFA-92595 AC 8; TFA-92595 How it works 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T4 'Mark Encounter Complete' is present and functional from all three toggles (Note, Tasks, Meds), not just Note. (TFA-92595 AC 7; TFA-92595 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient in note-ready with one open task (keep/cancel); one with one open and one done task (delete); one with exactly one open task (tick it off, then complete at once); one with a note but status 'seen'

When Mark Encounter Complete → Cancel — go back; Mark Encounter Complete → Keep Tasks & Mark Complete. Separately: Mark Encounter Complete → Delete Pending Tasks & Complete. Separately: tasks toggle → complete the last task → Mark Encounter Complete at once. …

Then The prompt says '1 task still pending'; Cancel leaves Mark Encounter Complete available; Keep → 'Encounter Complete', status post-rounded and the task still open in the database; Delete → 'Encounter Complete', status post-rounded and the stored task list is exactly the done task; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: a database read after Keep and after Delete; Cancel is UI-only (the button is visible again, no status or task read). Boundary 1 → 0 open tasks, and the only existing evidence that completion works from the Tasks toggle (T4). Hospital only, one patient per test: two patients and the Meds/Note toggles are S04, Nursing Home is S09. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-17/S03

Existing specs: the Pending Tasks prompt and completion — Keep keeps the task, Cancel leaves the button, Delete removes only the pending tasks, 0 open tasks skips the prompt, completion waits for the derived data

Tickets: TFA-92595 Post-Round Review & Completion (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-17.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — completion waits for derived encounter data — expected
  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — completing the last task bypasses the pending-task prompt — expected
  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — pending tasks require an explicit keep-or-delete decision — expected
  • rounding-workflows.spec.ts [chromium] — finishing can explicitly discard only the pending tasks — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs (chromium), which create and seed fresh @roundai.test accounts through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one shared account (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
